During the [[CSA–Trianii War]], the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] '''invaded''' the [[Trian system/Legends|Trian system]] with a force commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jiprin Kosh]]. The Corporate Sector Authority force was countered by fifteen [[Trianii Rangers]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The Rangers surrounded the invasion force, wiping out the majority of their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and motivator systems, leaving Kosh's vessel dead in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Captain Kosh offered to surrender, but the Trianii boarded their vessel and slaughtered their way to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="EGTAS" />

Kosh and the command staff were taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], and the Trianii transported them to their lead vessel. Kosh was forced, on their knees, to account for their presence in the Trian system and then to apologize for the intrusion. Following this, Kosh and the command staff were returned to their own ship and allowed to leave, limping back to their home and carrying a warning back to the Corporate Sector Authority not to test the Trianii further.<ref name="EGTAS" />
